dictionary.title: System Logs
dictionary.redaction_hint: Recognizable secrets are redacted in both the view and exports. Review files before sharing them.
dictionary.remote_limit: Only server audit events explicitly linked to this device are available. The device does not expose its own remote logs.
dictionary.unreachable: This log source is unavailable. Check the device connection and access permissions.
dictionary.limit_reached: The sample limit was reached. Narrow the time range or search to inspect more relevant events.
dictionary.scope_hint: Counts and findings refer only to the selected device, source and filters. They do not certify the health of the whole system.
dictionary.no_patterns: No recognized error patterns in this sample. Other problems may still be present.
dictionary.source_scan_hint: Sources are discovered on this machine. Inventory refreshes every 15 seconds; select a row to read it.
dictionary.device_unavailable: Device control is unavailable until its identity is known.
dictionary.advice_python_dependency_missing: The runtime could not import a required module. Verify the deployed requirements and rebuild the affected service before restarting it.
dictionary.advice_dns_failure: The machine could not resolve a hostname. Check its DNS and network connection, then repeat the failed operation.
dictionary.advice_permission_denied: Inspect the affected file or service permissions. Grant only the access the service needs.
dictionary.advice_connection_refused: Check whether the target service is running and listening on the expected interface and port.
dictionary.service_discovery_unavailable: Service inventory could not be read.
dictionary.container_discovery_unavailable: Container inventory could not be read.
dictionary.untimed_hint: {count} untimed events cannot be reliably restricted to the selected time range.
dictionary.stale_hint: Visible entries belong to the last successful read.
